transcript.text: Thank you all for joining. I've called this meeting because the internal review identified payments involving a foreign reseller that triggered sanctions-screening alerts, and we need to work through this together. As you know, no communication has gone to OFAC yet, the reseller relationship is still active, and we're still holding funds connected to those reviewed payments. Before we can make any decision about a regulator submission or any action on the reseller, company policy requires me to conduct a final review with sanctions, trade compliance, treasury, and commercial operations. And critically, before I sign off, each functional lead needs to formally disclose any material finding on the record -- not just discuss it verbally -- so it can be cited in the final package. So I'd like to go around the table and have each of you walk us through what your team has found. Let's start with sanctions.
